body.heading: Equation of decrees of court with settlements.
body.raw_text: 23. Every order made under sections 20 or 22 shall be embodied in a decree which shall for the purposes of the settlement order to be made under section 5 (5), if and in so far as by such decree the claim of any claimant is dismissed, be equivalent to and be deemed to be an agreement for the withdrawal of such claim under section 5 (4) (c) and, if and in so far as by such decree any claimant is declared to be entitled as against the State to any land or to any share of or interest in any land, be equivalent to and be deemed to be a declaration by the Settlement Officer under section 5 (4) (a) or (b) that such land is not claimed by the State or that some person unascertained is entitled to such share of or interest in such land, as the case may be.

body.heading: Award of compensation by the Minister.
body.raw_text: 26. Nothing in this Ordinance shall be deemed to prevent the Minister, if any claim is established to his satisfaction and notwithstanding that the claimant has not made his claim within the time prescribed by this Ordinance, or has not made a statement of claim upon being noticed by the District Judge under section 14 or has not appeared and stated the particulars of his claim in pursuance of a notice affixed on or near any land under section 15, from awarding to the claimant such compensation in land or in money or in land and money as the Minister may think proper.

body.heading: Persons engaged in carrying out order of Settlement Officer, &c, to be public servants.
body.raw_text: 27. Every person engaged in carrying out any order made by the Settlement Officer, the board, or any District Judge in pursuance of the powers or duties conferred or imposed by this Ordinance shall be deemed to be a public servant within the meaning of the Penal Code.

body.raw_text: 28. body.heading: Verification of service of process.
body.raw_text: 29. Every return made by a Fiscal to process issued under section 5 (3) shall be duly verified by the oath or affirmation of the officer employed to execute the same, and for such purpose the Fiscal is hereby authorized to administer such oath or affirmation.

body.heading: Proceedings under the Ordinance not invalidated by change of Settlement Officers.
body.raw_text: 30. Any proceedings instituted or taken under this Ordinance by any person as under the Settlement Officer may be continued by any other person as Settlement Officer.

body.heading: Protection of Settlement Officer.
body.raw_text: 31. The Settlement Officer shall not be liable in damages by reason of anything in good faith done or omitted to be done in his official capacity.
